blocks.heading: A reviewer with no desktop app
blocks.body:
Some people will not install Oxygen. They still need a way to read a change and leave a comment.

**Content Fusion** is one Syncro Soft answer: you share a change set. They open it in a browser. That is the whole apple today.

It is not a second home for the files. The booklet and the pages still live in the folder you already use (or in Git, tomorrow). If your shop has no Fusion, you still write the four lines. A labeled mock counts.

blocks.q: A reviewer will not install Oxygen. One Syncro Soft answer is Content Fusion. What is it for?
options: Share a change so they can comment in a browser
Replace the booklet with a new file type
blocks.why: Fusion is a share around the files you already have. It is not a second desk and not last week’s publish button.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: You already have Track Changes comments on a file, and you start a Fusion share on the same file without finishing the first pile. What goes wrong?
options: Status hides. Nobody knows which comment is the real one
blocks.why: One review pile per file. Finish or drop the first before you start a second.
